build_UNetWB: build a UNetWB model with weighted normalization layers for image processing with skip connections
build_UNetWBConcat: build a UNetWBConcat model that uses concatenation instead of addition for skip connections in the decoder
build_UNetW: build a UNetW model with weight normalization layers for image-to-image translation tasks
review_UNetWB_forward: review the UNetWB forward pass that uses addition-based skip connections between encoder and decoder stages
review_UNetWBConcat_forward: review the UNetWBConcat forward pass that concatenates skip connection features along the channel dimension
